boardName: Kolkata Municipal Corporation (Water Dept.) — Bulk/Housing-Complex Connections

connectionTypes.verifiedByNote: IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: this file models KMC's BULK/housing-complex domestic tariff (housing complexes, gated communities, and buildings owned by government/public bodies with under 25% non-residential use) — NOT an ordinary single-family house. KMC's own official schedule has no separate per-KL or slab tariff for an individual house at all; ordinary domestic water charges in Kolkata are understood to be bundled into property tax rather than billed volumetrically, which this site does not model. The ₹6/KL bulk rate is a genuine single flat rate (not telescopic/slabbed) regardless of volume. No sewerage/conservancy charge line item appears anywhere in KMC's water supply fee schedule — sewerageChargePercent is 0 here because none was found, not because a zero rate was confirmed; KMC likely collects conservancy charges separately through property tax. 'Fixed charge' here is genuine monthly meter rent by pipe diameter (always additive), not a minimum-bill floor. Commercial/industrial (Bulk ICI) and multi-storeyed-building rates are sourced but not yet modeled here.

verifiedBy: SOURCED (primary, official) — KMC's own official 'Rates, Taxes, Fees & Charges for the Year 2026-2027' schedule, Water Supply Department section, fetched directly from kmcgov.in and read in full. The document states the rates apply to FY 2026-2027 but does not cite a specific resolution number or a precise within-year effective date, so 2026-04-01 (fiscal-year start) is used as a reasonable estimate, not a confirmed date. The ₹6/KL bulk-domestic rate and the meter-rent-by-pipe-size table are both stated directly and unambiguously in the source; the absence of a sewerage charge and of any individual-house tariff were confirmed by reading the complete water-supply fee schedule, not inferred from a partial excerpt.
